# Hightouch

> Hightouch is a Composable CDP and Agentic Marketing Platform that enables data-driven marketing through AI Decisioning, customer data activation, and autonomous AI agents powered by warehouse-native architecture.

Hightouch specializes in composable customer data platforms, AI-powered marketing automation, and agentic workflows. The platform integrates with data warehouses like Snowflake and tools like Segment and Iterable to deliver personalized customer experiences through AI Decisioning and Adaptive Identity Resolution.

## Key Topics

- Composable CDP
- AI Decisioning
- Agentic Marketing Platform
- AI Agents & Agentic Workflows
- Marketing Automation & Personalization
- Adaptive Identity Resolution
- Customer Data Activation
- Data Warehouse Integration
- Lifecycle Marketing
- Machine Learning for Marketing
- MarTech Stack Optimization
- First-Party Data Strategy
- AI Experiments & Testing
- Customer Retention & Churn Prevention
